title: Piano with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Piano body -->
  <rect x="10" y="30" width="80" height="50" rx="6" fill="#7B3FA0"/>
  <!-- Lid / top panel -->
  <rect x="10" y="25" width="80" height="12" rx="5" fill="#9B5FC0"/>
  <!-- Lid highlight -->
  <rect x="14" y="27" width="72" height="4" rx="2" fill="#B77FD8"/>
  <!-- Keyboard white keys area -->
  <rect x="16" y="52" width="68" height="18" rx="3" fill="#F0E8FF"/>
  <!-- White keys -->
  <rect x="18" y="54" width="8" height="14" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="27" y="54" width="8" height="14" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="36" y="54" width="8" height="14" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="45" y="54" width="8" height="14" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="54" y="54" width="8" height="14" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="63" y="54" width="8" height="14" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="72" y="54" width="8" height="14" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Black keys -->
  <rect x="23" y="53" width="5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#3A1F50"/>
  <rect x="32" y="53" width="5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#3A1F50"/>
  <rect x="50" y="53" width="5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#3A1F50"/>
  <rect x="59" y="53" width="5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#3A1F50"/>
  <rect x="68" y="53" width="5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#3A1F50"/>
  <!-- Keyboard base -->
  <rect x="14" y="68" width="72" height="6" rx="3" fill="#C8A8E8"/>
  <!-- Smiling face on lid area -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="40" r="5" fill="#FFE94A"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="40" r="5" fill="#FFE94A"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="39.5" cy="38.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFF8D0"/>
  <circle cx="63.5" cy="38.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFF8D0"/>
  <!-- Mouth smile -->
  <path d="M40 46 Q50 56 60 46" stroke="#FFE94A" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="45" r="4" fill="#FF9BD0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="45" r="4" fill="#FF9BD0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Little music notes floating -->
  <g fill="#FFE94A">
    <ellipse cx="82" cy="20" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" transform="rotate(-15 82 20)"/>
    <rect x="84.5" y="12" width="1.8" height="8" rx="0.9"/>
    <path d="M84.5 12 Q90 10 90 14 Q89 12 86.3 12.5" fill="#FFE94A"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#7FFFD4">
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="18" rx="3" ry="2.2" transform="rotate(10 18 18)"/>
    <rect x="20" y="11" width="1.6" height="7" rx="0.8"/>
    <path d="M20 11 Q14 9 14 12.5 Q15 11 18.4 11.4" fill="#7FFFD4"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Piano legs -->
  <rect x="20" y="76" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#5A2A78"/>
  <rect x="74" y="76" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#5A2A78"/>
  <!-- Center leg / pedal area -->
  <rect x="46" y="76" width="8" height="8" rx="2" fill="#6B3A8A"/>
  <!-- Pedals -->
  <rect x="44" y="84" width="4" height="3" rx="1" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <rect x="52" y="84" width="4" height="3" rx="1" fill="#FFD700"/>
</svg>
